# Leaflet 1.9.4

The files in this directory are the official Leaflet 1.9.4 distribution assets
from <https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/releases/tag/v1.9.4>.

Leaflet is distributed under BSD-2-Clause; the full license is in `LICENSE.txt`.
The official JavaScript is kept intact. CSS indentation is normalized to the
repository's whitespace rules. ACULTA's map behavior and marker clustering are
implemented separately in the module's `js/` directory.
